info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Resource Groups API

params.name: orgId
params.description: List resource groups in this organization. Only admin users of another organization (such as partners) may use this parameter.

items.docs:
List resource groups.

Use query parameters to filter the response.

params.name: resourceGroupId
params.description: The unique identifier for the resource group.

items.docs:
Shows details for a resource group, by ID.

Specify the resource group ID in the `resourceGroupId` parameter in the URI.
